newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian envoy to EU said preparing to resign.
newsitem.headline: Colombian envoy to EU said preparing to resign.

text.p: Colombia's ambassador to the European Union, linked in recent news reports to right-wing paramilitary activity, is preparing to resign, a senior government official said on Thursday.

The official, who spoke on condition of anonymity, said Carlos Arturo Marulanda was likely to tender his resignation "within the next few days" and the government would name his replacement in the Brussels-based post as soon as possible.

No further details were immediately available but Foreign Minister Maria Emma Mejia told reporters on Thursday that growing pressure from some European countries and human rights groups for Marulanda's removal had been a cause of "enormous concern" to Bogota. She said a decision would be made "very soon" but did not comment further.

Recent editorial comments and a lengthy expose in Bogota's El Espectador newspaper have linked Marulanda and his brother to paramilitary activity and the eviction of landless peasants from their family's sprawling Bellacruz estate in northern Cesar province. In a letter to El Espectador published last Sunday, Marulanda denied any wrongdoing.
